articles.summary: LOUISVILLE, Ky., Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Texas Roadhouse, Inc. (NasdaqGS: TXRH), today announced financial results for the 13 and 39 weeks ended September 29, 2026.
